sentences.zh: 夏，四月，段遼以車數千兩輸乙連粟，蘭勃擊而取之。

translations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Duan Liao transported grain to Yilian with several thousand carts; Lan Bo attacked and seized it.
translations.idiomatic: In summer, the fourth month, Duan Liao transported grain to Yilian with several thousand carts; Lan Bo attacked and seized the convoy.

sentences.zh: 六月，遼又遣其從弟揚威將軍屈雲，將精騎夜襲皝子遵於興國城，遵擊破之。

translations.literal: In the sixth month Liao again sent his cousin General Who Displays Might Qu Yun with elite cavalry in a night raid on Huang's son Zun at Xingguo city; Zun defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month Liao again sent his cousin General Who Displays Might Qu Yun with elite cavalry in a night raid on Huang's son Murong Zun at Xingguo; Zun defeated them.

sentences.zh: 初，北平陽裕事段疾陸眷及遼五世，皆見尊禮。

translations.literal: Earlier, Yang Yu of Beiping served Duan Jilujuan and Liao for five generations and was honored and treated with ceremony in each.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, Yang Yu of Beiping had served Duan Jilujuan and Liao for five generations and was honored in each reign.

sentences.zh: 遼數與皝相攻，裕諫曰：「『親仁善鄰，國之寶也。』

translations.literal: Liao repeatedly attacked Huang; Yu remonstrated: "'To cherish benevolence and befriend neighbors is the treasure of a state.
translations.idiomatic: Liao repeatedly fought Huang; Yu remonstrated, "'To cherish benevolence and befriend neighbors is the treasure of a state.

sentences.zh: 況慕容氏與我世婚，迭為甥舅，皝有才德，而我與之構怨；

translations.literal: Moreover the Murong clan and we have intermarried for generations, alternately nephews and uncles-in-law; Huang has talent and virtue, yet we bear grudges against him;
translations.idiomatic: Moreover the Murong clan and we have intermarried for generations, alternately nephews and uncles-in-law; Huang has talent and virtue, yet we bear grudges against him;

sentences.zh: 戰無虛月，百姓凋弊，利不補害，臣恐社稷之憂將由此始。

translations.literal: battles without a month of peace, the people wasted and ruined, gains not compensating harm—I fear the state's peril will begin from this.
translations.idiomatic: we fight without a month of peace, the people are wasted and ruined, and gains do not compensate harm—I fear the state's peril will begin here.

sentences.zh: 願兩追前失，通好如初，以安國息民。」

translations.literal: I wish both sides would pursue and remedy past errors, restore friendly relations as before, and settle the state and give the people rest."
translations.idiomatic: I wish both sides would remedy past errors, restore friendly relations as before, and settle the state and give the people rest."

sentences.zh: 遼不從，出裕為北平相。

translations.literal: Liao did not follow his counsel and sent Yu out as Administrator of Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: Liao did not follow his counsel and sent Yu out as Administrator of Beiping.

sentences.zh: 趙太子邃素驍勇，趙王虎愛之，常謂群臣曰：「司馬氏父子兄弟自相殘滅，故使朕得至此；

translations.literal: The Zhao crown prince Sui was by nature fierce and brave; King Hu of Zhao loved him and often said to the assembled ministers: "The Sima clan, fathers and sons and brothers, slaughtered one another, and therefore enabled me to reach this point;
translations.idiomatic: The Zhao crown prince Shi Sui was by nature fierce and brave; King Hu loved him and often told the ministers, "The Sima clan slaughtered one another, fathers, sons, and brothers, and that is how I reached this point;

sentences.zh: 如朕有殺阿鐵理否？」

translations.literal: have I killed A-Tieli or not?"
translations.idiomatic: have I killed my own kin or not?"

sentences.zh: 既而邃驕淫殘忍，好妝飾美姬，斬其首，洗血置盤上，與賓客傳觀之，又烹其肉共食之。

translations.literal: Soon Sui grew arrogant, licentious, and cruel; he loved to adorn beautiful concubines, beheaded them, washed the blood and set it on a platter to pass among guests for viewing, and also boiled their flesh and ate it together.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Sui grew arrogant, licentious, and cruel; he loved to adorn beautiful concubines, beheaded them, washed the blood and set it on a platter for guests to pass around, and boiled their flesh and ate it with his guests.

sentences.zh: 河間公宣、樂安公韜皆有寵於虎，邃疾之如仇。

translations.literal: The Duke of Hejian Xuan and the Duke of Le'an Tao both enjoyed Hu's favor; Sui hated them like enemies.
translations.idiomatic: The Duke of Hejian Shi Xuan and the Duke of Le'an Shi Tao both enjoyed Hu's favor; Sui hated them like enemies.

sentences.zh: 虎荒耽酒色，喜怒無常。

translations.literal: Hu was dissolute in wine and women, his joy and anger without constancy.
translations.idiomatic: Hu was dissolute in wine and women, his moods unpredictable.

sentences.zh: 使邃省可尚書事，每有所關白，虎恚曰：「此小事，何足白也！」

translations.literal: He had Sui review matters presented to the Masters of Writing that could be approved; whenever Sui reported something, Hu raged: "This is a trifle—what need to report it!"
translations.idiomatic: He had Sui review routine memorials to the Masters of Writing; whenever Sui reported something, Hu raged, "This is a trifle—why report it!"

sentences.zh: 時或不聞，又恚曰：「何以不白！」

translations.literal: At times he did not hear of matters and raged again: "Why did you not report it!"
translations.idiomatic: At times he heard nothing and raged again, "Why did you not report it!"

sentences.zh: 誚責笞棰，月至再三。

translations.literal: He reviled, blamed, flogged, and beat him, as often as two or three times a month.
translations.idiomatic: He reviled, blamed, flogged, and beat him two or three times a month.

sentences.zh: 邃私謂中庶子李顏等曰：「官家難稱，吾欲行冒頓之事，卿從我乎？」

translations.literal: Sui privately said to Palace Companion Li Yan and others: "The master is hard to please; I wish to do what Maodun did—will you follow me?"
translations.idiomatic: Sui privately told Palace Companion Li Yan and others, "The old man is impossible to please; I want to do what Maodun did—will you follow me?"

sentences.zh: 顏等伏不敢對。

translations.literal: Yan and the others prostrated themselves and dared not answer.
translations.idiomatic: Yan and the others prostrated themselves and dared not answer.

sentences.zh: 秋，七月，邃稱疾不視事，潛帥宮臣文武五百餘騎飲於李顏別捨，因謂顏等曰：「我欲至冀州殺河間公，有不從者斬！」

translations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, Sui claimed illness and did not attend to affairs; he secretly led more than five hundred palace officials, civil and military, on horseback to drink at Li Yan's separate lodge, and then said to Yan and the others: "I wish to go to Ji province and kill the Duke of Hejian—whoever does not follow, behead him!"
translations.idiomatic: In autumn, the seventh month, Sui claimed illness and neglected affairs; he secretly led more than five hundred palace officials on horseback to drink at Li Yan's lodge and told Yan and the others, "I am going to Ji province to kill the Duke of Hejian—whoever does not follow will be beheaded!"

sentences.zh: 行數里，騎皆逃散。

translations.literal: After traveling several li, the horsemen all fled and scattered.
translations.idiomatic: After traveling several li, the horsemen all fled and scattered.

sentences.zh: 顏叩頭固諫，邃亦昏醉而歸。

translations.literal: Yan kowtowed and firmly remonstrated; Sui also returned in drunken stupor.
translations.idiomatic: Yan kowtowed and firmly remonstrated; Sui returned in a drunken stupor.

sentences.zh: 其母鄭氏聞之，私遣中人誚讓邃；

translations.literal: His mother the Lady Zheng heard of it and privately sent a palace attendant to reproach Sui;
translations.idiomatic: His mother Lady Zheng heard of it and privately sent a palace attendant to reproach Sui;

sentences.zh: 邃怒，殺之。

translations.literal: Sui grew angry and killed him.
translations.idiomatic: Sui grew angry and killed him.

sentences.zh: 佛圖澄謂虎曰：「陛下不宜數往東宮。」

translations.literal: Fotudeng said to Hu: "Your Majesty ought not go often to the Eastern Palace."
translations.idiomatic: Fotudeng told Hu, "Your Majesty ought not visit the Eastern Palace so often."

sentences.zh: 虎將視邃疾，思澄言而還；

translations.literal: Hu was about to visit Sui's illness, recalled Chen's words, and turned back;
translations.idiomatic: Hu was about to visit Sui's sickbed, recalled Fotudeng's words, and turned back;

sentences.zh: 既而瞋目大言曰：「我為天下主，父子不相信乎！」

translations.literal: then glared and cried aloud: "I am master of the realm—shall father and son not trust one another!"
translations.idiomatic: then glared and cried aloud, "I am master of the realm—shall father and son not trust one another!"

sentences.zh: 乃命所親信女尚書往察之。

translations.literal: He then ordered a trusted female Master of Writing to go inspect.
translations.idiomatic: He then ordered a trusted female Master of Writing to go inspect.

sentences.zh: 邃呼前與語，因抽劍擊之。

translations.literal: Sui summoned her forward to speak and then drew his sword and struck her.
translations.idiomatic: Sui summoned her forward to speak and then drew his sword and struck her.

sentences.zh: 虎怒，收李顏等詰問，顏具言其狀。

translations.literal: Hu grew angry, seized Li Yan and others for interrogation, and Yan fully recounted the circumstances.
translations.idiomatic: Hu grew furious, seized Li Yan and others for interrogation, and Yan fully recounted what had happened.

sentences.zh: 殺顏等三十餘人；

translations.literal: He killed Yan and more than thirty others;
translations.idiomatic: He killed Yan and more than thirty others;

sentences.zh: 幽邃於東宮，既而赦之，引見太武東堂；

translations.literal: imprisoned Sui in the Eastern Palace, then pardoned him and summoned him to audience at the Hall of Grand Martiality East;
translations.idiomatic: imprisoned Sui in the Eastern Palace, then pardoned him and summoned him to audience at the Hall of Grand Martiality East;

sentences.zh: 邃朝而不謝，俄頃即出。

translations.literal: Sui attended court but did not thank him and presently went out.
translations.idiomatic: Sui attended court but did not thank him and presently left.

sentences.zh: 虎使謂之曰：「太子應朝中宮，豈可遽去！」

translations.literal: Hu sent someone to tell him: "The crown prince ought to attend the inner palace—how can you leave so hastily!"
translations.idiomatic: Hu sent someone to tell him, "The crown prince ought to attend the inner palace—how can you leave so hastily!"

sentences.zh: 邃徑出，不顧。

translations.literal: Sui went straight out without looking back.
translations.idiomatic: Sui went straight out without looking back.

sentences.zh: 虎大怒，廢邃為庶人。

translations.literal: Hu was greatly enraged and deposed Sui as a commoner.
translations.idiomatic: Hu was greatly enraged and deposed Sui as a commoner.

sentences.zh: 其夜，殺邃及其妃張氏，並男女二十六人同埋於一棺；

translations.literal: That night he killed Sui and his consort the Lady Zhang, and together with twenty-six sons and daughters buried them in a single coffin;
translations.idiomatic: That night he killed Sui and his consort Lady Zhang, and buried them together with twenty-six sons and daughters in a single coffin;

sentences.zh: 誅其宮臣支黨二百餘人；

translations.literal: executed more than two hundred of his palace officials and their factions;
translations.idiomatic: executed more than two hundred of his palace officials and their factions;

sentences.zh: 廢鄭後為東海太妃。

translations.literal: deposed Queen Zheng as Grand Consort of Donghai.
translations.idiomatic: deposed Queen Zheng as Grand Consort of Donghai.

sentences.zh: 立其子宣為天王皇太子，宣母杜昭儀為天王皇后。

translations.literal: He installed his son Xuan as Heavenly King Crown Prince and Xuan's mother Lady Du, Palace Lady of Splendid Beauty, as Heavenly King Queen.
translations.idiomatic: He installed his son Shi Xuan as Heavenly King Crown Prince and Xuan's mother Lady Du, Palace Lady of Splendid Beauty, as Heavenly King Queen.

sentences.zh: 安定侯子光，自稱佛太子，雲從大秦國來，當王小秦國，聚眾數千人於杜南山，自稱大黃帝，改元龍興；

translations.literal: The Marquis of Anding Ziguan styled himself Buddha Crown Prince, claiming he came from Great Qin and would be king of Little Qin; he gathered several thousand followers on Dushan Mountain, styled himself Great Yellow Emperor, and changed the era to Longxing;
translations.idiomatic: The Marquis of Anding Ziguan styled himself Buddha Crown Prince, claiming he came from Great Qin and would be king of Little Qin; he gathered several thousand followers on Dushan Mountain, styled himself Great Yellow Emperor, and changed the era name to Longxing;

sentences.zh: 石廣討斬之。

translations.literal: Shi Guang campaigned against him and beheaded him.
translations.idiomatic: Shi Guang campaigned against him and beheaded him.

sentences.zh: 九月，鎮軍左長史封弈等勸慕容皝稱燕王；

translations.literal: In the ninth month Left Chief Clerk of the Army Who Pacifies Feng Yi and others urged Murong Huang to style himself King of Yan;
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Left Chief Clerk of the Army Who Pacifies Feng Yi and others urged Murong Huang to style himself King of Yan;

sentences.zh: 皝從之。

translations.literal: Huang followed their counsel.
translations.idiomatic: Huang followed their counsel.

sentences.zh: 於是備置群司，以封弈為國相，韓壽為司馬，裴開為奉常，陽騖為司隸，王寓為太僕，李洪為大理，杜群為納言令，宋該、劉睦、石琮為常伯，皇甫真、陽協為冗騎常侍，宋晃、平熙、張泓為將軍，封裕為記室監。

translations.literal: Thereupon he fully established the ministries and bureaus, appointing Feng Yi Chancellor of State, Han Shou Major, Pei Kai Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Yang Ji Director of the Masters of Law, Wang Yu Grand Master of the Palace Stud, Li Hong Grand Judge, Du Qun Director of Proclamations, Song Gai, Liu Mu, and Shi Cong Regular Grandees, Huangfu Zhen and Yang Xie Regular Attendants of the Idle Cavalry, Song Huang, Ping Xi, and Zhang Hong Generals, and Feng Yu Supervisor of the Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: He then fully established the ministries, appointing Feng Yi Chancellor of State, Han Shou Major, Pei Kai Grand Master of Splendid Happiness, Yang Ji Director of the Masters of Law, Wang Yu Grand Master of the Palace Stud, Li Hong Grand Judge, Du Qun Director of Proclamations, Song Gai, Liu Mu, and Shi Cong Regular Grandees, Huangfu Zhen and Yang Xie Regular Attendants of the Idle Cavalry, Song Huang, Ping Xi, and Zhang Hong as generals, and Feng Yu Supervisor of the Secretariat.

sentences.zh: 洪，臻之孫；

translations.literal: Hong was the grandson of Zhen;
translations.idiomatic: Hong was the grandson of Li Zhen;

sentences.zh: 晃，奭之子也。

translations.literal: Huang was the son of Shi.
translations.idiomatic: Huang was the son of Song Shi.

sentences.zh: 冬，十月，丁卯，皝即燕王位，大赦。

translations.literal: In winter, the tenth month, on dingmao Huang assumed the kingship of Yan and proclaimed a general amnesty.
translations.idiomatic: In winter, the tenth month, on dingmao Huang assumed the kingship of Yan and proclaimed a general amnesty.

sentences.zh: 十一月，甲寅，追尊武宣公曰武宣王，夫人段氏曰武宣後；

translations.literal: In the eleventh month, on jiayin he posthumously honored the Duke of Martial Proclamation as King of Martial Proclamation and Lady Duan as Queen of Martial Proclamation;
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on jiayin he posthumously honored the Duke of Martial Proclamation as King of Martial Proclamation and Lady Duan as Queen of Martial Proclamation;

sentences.zh: 立夫人段氏為王后，世子俊為王太子，如魏武、晉文輔政故事。

translations.literal: he installed Lady Duan as queen, heir apparent Jun as crown prince, following the precedent of Wei Wu and Jin Wen in aiding government.
translations.idiomatic: he installed Lady Duan as queen and heir apparent Murong Jun as crown prince, following the precedent of Cao Cao and Sima Yi in aiding government.

sentences.zh: 段遼數侵趙邊，燕王皝遣揚烈將軍宋回稱籓於趙，乞師以討遼，自請盡帥國中之眾以會之，並以其弟寧遠將軍汗為質。

translations.literal: Duan Liao repeatedly raided Zhao's borders; King Huang of Yan sent General Who Displays Fierceness Song Hui to declare himself a vassal of Zhao, beg troops to attack Liao, offer personally to lead all the forces of the state to join, and send his younger brother General Who Pacifies the Far Han as hostage.
translations.idiomatic: Duan Liao repeatedly raided Zhao's borders; King Huang of Yan sent General Who Displays Fierceness Song Hui to declare himself Zhao's vassal, beg troops to attack Liao, offer to lead all his forces to join the campaign, and send his younger brother General Who Pacifies the Far Murong Han as hostage.

sentences.zh: 趙王虎大悅，厚加慰答，辭其質，遣還，密期以明年。

translations.literal: King Hu of Zhao was greatly pleased, responded with generous consolation, declined the hostage and sent him back, and secretly fixed the date for the next year.
translations.idiomatic: King Hu was greatly pleased, responded generously, declined the hostage and sent him back, and secretly fixed the campaign for the next year.

sentences.zh: 是歲，趙將李穆納拓跋翳槐於大寧，其故部落多歸之。

translations.literal: That year the Zhao general Li Mu received Tuoba Yihua at Daning; many of his former tribes returned to him.
translations.idiomatic: That year the Zhao general Li Mu received Tuoba Yihua at Daning; many of his former tribes returned to him.

sentences.zh: 代王紇那奔燕，國人復奉翳槐為代王，翳槐城盛樂而居之。

translations.literal: The Dai king Hena fled to Yan; the people of the state again upheld Yihua as Dai king, and Yihua walled Shengle and dwelt there.
translations.idiomatic: The Dai king Hena fled to Yan; the people again upheld Yihua as Dai king, and Yihua walled Shengle and made it his seat.

sentences.zh: 仇池氐王楊毅族兄初，襲殺毅，並有其眾，自立為仇池公，稱臣於趙。

translations.literal: Yang Chu, a clansman of the Di king of Chouchi Yang Yi, raided and killed Yi, seized his followers, installed himself as Duke of Chouchi, and declared himself a vassal of Zhao.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Chu, a clansman of the Di king of Chouchi Yang Yi, raided and killed Yi, seized his followers, installed himself as Duke of Chouchi, and declared himself Zhao's vassal.
